A newline inside two nested spans after an emphasis still separates the words on either side

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p><i>Alpha</i><span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
